eligibility.quote: MAVLink move some of messages between dialects, that's not a problem for the protocol itself or C implementation, but for C++ it is because here i have a namespace for each dialect.

loudness.quote:

resolution.quote:
fix: update GLOBAL_POSITION_INT message type to standard namespace
-    mavlink::common::msg::GLOBAL_POSITION_INT & gpos,
+    mavlink::standard::msg::GLOBAL_POSITION_INT & gpos,

notes: Independently verified against the release-tag files: common.xml at release/humble/mavlink/2025.9.9-1 line 5427 contains "<message id="33" name="GLOBAL_POSITION_INT">"; common.xml at 2025.12.12-1 no longer defines it (only textual references and GLOBAL_POSITION_INT_COV at line 5769); standard.xml at 2025.12.12-1 line 115 defines "<message id="33" name="GLOBAL_POSITION_INT">" — exactly the spec's claim, and it contradicts the maintainer's in-thread remark "i've checked build, and 2025.12.12 has the same standard.xml as 2025.9.9"; the spec correctly follows the primary files. Issue #2088: the compile error is verbatim (with curly quotes as in the source); the rosinstall block shows "version: release/humble/mavlink/2025.12.12-1"; reporter confirms "Yes, it works with 2025.9.9."; maintainer: "Ah, i overlooked https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/commit/42d26080d197f173947e8636abc6bbd295acb07a - so, i'll release 2.14.0 today.". Commit 42d26080's message and patch are verbatim as quoted. Eligibility: the provider moved the message between dialects, changing the C++ symbol the consumer references — E2.4's parenthetical (rebuilding a consumer because a provider's definition changed is an interface change) makes stop_step 6 right; operation UPGRADE with consumer_built_against broken=2025.9.9-1 documented ("Try previous mavlink 2025.9.9." + "Yes, it works with 2025.9.9.") is right. Class element_removed_or_renamed fits the symbol disappearing from the common namespace. Loudness loud_documented/build via the compiler error. Resolution recommended is right: the only working composition shown in the thread is the downgrade (2025.9.9); nothing shows mavros 2.14.0 building against mavlink 2025.12.12.
